title: Intercontinental Rocketry Forked: Updated
author: Lessen_Freem; FactorioMods (Factorio 2.1 port)
description:
Factorio 2.1 compatibility fork of intercontinental-rocketry-forked. Fork of Intercontinental Rocketry 
Every planet in Space Age, generates additional subplanets, allowing you to start fresh with any planet at any time. The settings allow you to control which planets get copied and how many copies you want.
